title: ES-MOVESET/1 — the per-weapon moveset contract
description: Every file under game/data/combat/movesets/<weapon-id>.json MUST validate against this schema. It is the declared half of the two-source rule in HARNESS.md §7.4: the critic diffs this file against the reference tables in RI-WPN01/02/04 and THEN confirms the harness trace agrees with this file. A mismatch between declared and observed is a hard fail.

weapon_id.description: Stable id. HARNESS.md §7.2: renaming breaks cross-wave comparison.

class.description: Weapon class code. RI-WPN02 §A is authoritative on the fifteen.

weight_tier.description: Drives hitstop and impact tables in RI-WPN05 §A. Must match the class's tier in RI-WPN02 §A.

baseline_ref.description: weapon_id of the class-baseline weapon this weapon inherits its clip family from, or null if this weapon IS the baseline. RI-WPN03 computes deviation against this.

off_hand.description: Present only when this weapon is legal in the offhand of a dual-wield configuration. Supplies the off.* slots. RI-WPN06 §C.

parry_capable.description: Whether this weapon may occupy the offhand parry role (RI-WPN06 §D). Non-parry classes MUST declare false; a true here with no parry slot is a schema error.

guardbreak_kind.description: Which guardbreak animation family this weapon uses. 'none' is legal ONLY for BOW.

arc_sweep_deg.description: Total angular travel of the hitbox capsule across the active window of slot r1.1, in the player's local yaw frame. The single most diagnostic per-class number after startup.

slots.description: Keyed by slot id. Every id in RI-WPN01 §B marked MANDATORY must be present. Absent mandatory slot = the weapon does not exist for scoring purposes.

allOf._comment: AMENDED wave 1 (W1-10, AMENDMENT-W1-10-01 D8). slots.minProperties was an unconditional 25, which denied the reduced table RI-WPN01 §A grants BOW in prose ('BOW is the one class permitted a reduced table ... a mandatory count of 7'). The conditional below is exactly what the item says.

exclusive_slots.description: Slot ids that exist ONLY in this stance. RI-WPN06 §B requires >= 2 for two_hand on every melee class.

anim.description: Animation clip id. THE load-bearing field of this schema. RI-WPN03's every measurement is a function of the multiset of clip ids across all weapons. Two slots with the same clip id MUST play byte-identical animation.

anim_owner.description: weapon_id that owns this clip. Equal to this file's weapon_id when the clip is unique to it. RI-WPN03 M2 counts unique clips by anim_owner == weapon_id.

chains_to.description: slot id this slot may chain into via the 8-frame combo buffer (RI-CMB02 §D.5), or null to terminate the chain.

startup_f.description: AMENDED wave 1 (W1-10, AMENDMENT-W1-10-01 D3): was 4..90, which forbade GHM R2 startup 96 and UGS R2 startup 104 (RI-WPN02 §B, rebased). Minimum raised to RI-CMB02 §E's 6 f@60 floor, which S22 does NOT rebase.

active_f.description: AMENDED wave 1 (W1-10, D1): was 2..16, the pre-S22 bound, which forbade the published jump.r1 active frames of HLB 18, GSW 20, CGS 23, GHM 20, UGS 25 (RI-WPN04 §A).

recovery_f.description: AMENDED wave 1 (W1-10, D2): was 6..90, which forbade GHM jump.r1 recovery 96 and UGS jump.r1 recovery 106 (RI-WPN04 §A).

charge_max_f.description: AMENDED wave 1 (W1-10, D4): maximum was 60, which forbade bow.aimed's published 90 f@60 draw (RI-WPN02 §C). RI-WPN01 §C.3's melee 1-60 range is prose the critic checks, not an encoding bound. Frames of hold inserted between startup and active. Non-zero ONLY on r2.charged / 2h.r2.charged / bow.aimed. Closes the combat.attack.charge hole.

shape.description: The attack's geometric family. RI-WPN03 requires shape variety inside a class; RI-WPN04 uses shape inequality as one of the fallback-detection tests.

poise_multiplier.description: Multiplier on the player's poise health while the window is open. Owned by RI-CMB05; declared here so the two sources can be diffed.

hitstop_f.description: Per-material attacker hitstop. Omitted means 'inherit the RI-WPN05 §A row for this weight_tier'. Present means this weapon overrides it and RI-WPN05 M1 checks the override, not the table.

cancels_into.description: RI-CMB02 §D is authoritative: dodge only, and only in the back 55% of recovery. Any other value is an AR-1 violation.

answers.description: RI-AI05 archetypes this slot is an intended answer to. Feeds the answer matrix in RI-WPN01 §E (BAR-CRITIQUE-01 G9).

peak_tip_speed_mps_implied.description: RI-WPN05 §E.2. Written by tools/weapons/build-movesets.mjs ONLY when this slot's declared arc, its weapon's reach_m and its active_f jointly imply a peak weapon-tip speed above §E.2's ceiling of 1.25x the tier's §E band top: peak = 1.5 * arc_rad * reach_m * 60 / active_f, where 1.5 is the exact maximum derivative of the smoothstep used between every key pair in game/src/combat/clips.js. Its ABSENCE is the pass condition. It is a derived indictment, never an input: nothing reads it back, and repairing the slot removes it.

trigger.description: The input contract. Buttons are the closed set from HARNESS.md §4; an unlisted button is a tooling error, not a silent no-op.

button.description: AMENDED wave 1 (W1-10, D5): carried 8 of HARNESS.md §4's 14 names while claiming to BE that closed set. Omitting swap_left forbade RI-WPN06 §C's mandatory O2 offhand slots outright.

state_window.description: The frame window, INSIDE the named state's own animation, during which the press produces this slot. RI-WPN04 §B is authoritative on every window.
